summary: Addex Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K on October 2, 2026, attaching a press release announcing executive management changes at the Swiss clinical-stage biopharma. Jean-Philippe Rocher was appointed Head of Pharmaceutical Development and a member of the Executive Management, while Mikhail Kalinichev, Head of Translational Science, decided to step down. The filing maps to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics were stated. The abrupt departure of a senior translational science executive alongside a new development hire warrants monitoring for pipeline continuity risks.
